summary.text: 做 is a colloquial graph associated with 作 and used for ‘do’, ‘act’, ‘make’ and ‘work’. Its current form is written 亻 beside 故; traditional accounts connect the character with 作, while the precise graphic path to this form remains uncertain.

formation.text: The supported broad account treats 做 as a colloquial graph of 作, so its formation is derived. One proposal gives an earlier form ⿰作攵 and says 乍 later became 古 through graphic corruption. That detailed path remains disputed: the reported 攴-bearing variant of 作 does not by itself show that 做 descended from it, and the modern split 亻 plus 故 does not prove an ancient compound.

history.text: 做 is reported as absent from Shuowen and as a colloquial graph of 作 in traditional dictionary accounts. A separate proposal traces it to 作 with 攵 and says 乍 was corrupted to resemble 古; a 攴-bearing bronze variant of 作 is also reported, but no evidence here links that variant to 做 or confirms the proposed corruption. The curated seal-script-style 作 image is a modern redraw used as a comparator, not an earlier form of 做.

做 is reported in a Ming dictionary and in later literary examples, but its earliest securely dated use is unresolved. A search-result transcription of a Kangxi note disputes separating 作 and 做 simply by tone; that account remains unverified because the page could not be inspected.

uncertainties.text: Dictionary accounts support an association between 做 and 作, but the exact graphic path to the current 亻故 form is unresolved. In particular, the proposed change from 乍 to 古 in 做 remains unconfirmed.
The earliest dated attestation and the chronology connecting the listed senses are unresolved; undated quotations and dictionary ordering do not establish a sequence.

senses.text: Current dictionary glosses include ‘do’ and ‘act’. The evidence does not establish which use came first.
Current glosses also include ‘make’ and ‘work’. Their listing does not establish a development to or from ‘do’.
Dictionary accounts list uses glossed ‘become’ or ‘serve as’, but do not date them or connect them historically to the other senses.
A dictionary lists a literary use glossed ‘pretend’; its date and relation to the other senses are unresolved.

limitations.text: The listed glosses and literary examples do not establish an earliest meaning or a dated semantic sequence.
The reported Water Margin quotation has no established edition or date here, so it cannot determine the earliest attested use.

overview.text: 做 is a colloquial graph associated with 作 and commonly means ‘do’ or ‘make’. Its present form is written 亻 beside 故, but that visible split does not explain how the character developed.

relationships.text: Traditional dictionary accounts identify 做 as a colloquial graph of 作. This supports a graphic and lexical association, but not a specific sequence leading to the current 亻故 form.
